summary: Fallow Lands can now react to an Attack that targets its province (Mendon's ruling, R-087): ResolveOrDeferAttack opens the attack reaction window for a province Attack when Fallow Lands can react, ValidateAbility refuses every other Attack reaction against it, and the deferred Attack still resolves its province effect. New Core suite fallow-lands-reaction.
validation: dotnet fallow-lands-reaction 3/3 pass and 0/3 on the old engine; bash tools/check.sh --skip-client all passed. Client not changed or run natively.
remaining: Other 'after an Attack is targeted' reactions (Khol Regulars, Precision...) still do not react to a province Attack; not asked for. Client window with no card target not checked natively.
